name: Arab National Bank
summary: Arab National Bank provides various banking products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Other GCC and the Middle East, Europe, North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and internationally. It operates through Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, and Investment and Brokerage Services segments. The company offers savings, Murabaha, and SME accounts; time deposits; personal, auto lease, and real estate loans; credit and debit cards; digital wallets; and investment products for individuals.
